_about: Held-out eval set for Scam Shield. NEVER use these as few-shot examples or for tuning keywords. 10 scam + 10 normal. 'hard' marks normal calls that share surface words with scams (bank, police, money, grandkid, code). Lines are 'Caller:' / 'You:'.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Hello, I'm calling from Microsoft technical support. Your computer has sent us an error message. It is infected with a dangerous virus.
You: Oh, I didn't know that.
Caller: Hackers can see your bank information right now. I need you to go to your computer and download a program so I can remove the virus.
You: Is this going to cost anything?
Caller: Just a small service fee of two hundred ninety nine dollars. You can pay with gift cards from any pharmacy. Please do not turn off the computer and do not hang up.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Good morning, I'm with the Medicare benefits office. We are sending everyone new plastic Medicare cards this month.
You: Oh, okay.
Caller: To mail yours, I just need to verify your Social Security number and your date of birth.
You: Shouldn't you already have that?
Caller: Our system was updated and we need you to confirm it today, or your benefits may be suspended.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Darling, it's David. I miss you so much. I can't wait until I finally get to meet you in person.
You: I miss you too. When are you coming?
Caller: That's the problem. My work equipment is stuck in customs here and they won't release it unless I pay a fee. My bank account is frozen while I'm overseas.
You: Oh no, how much is it?
Caller: Three thousand dollars. Could you wire it through Western Union today? I'll pay you back the moment I land. Please don't tell your daughter, she never trusted me.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Congratulations! This is the Publishers Prize Center. You've been selected as our grand prize winner of two point five million dollars and a new car!
You: Really? I don't remember entering.
Caller: You were entered automatically. To release your winnings, you just need to pay the taxes and processing fee of nine hundred dollars upfront.
You: Can't you take it out of the prize?
Caller: Unfortunately that's federal law. The offer expires at five o'clock today, so we need to process your payment right now.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: This is the disconnection department at the electric company. Your account is past due and a technician is on the way to shut off your power within thirty minutes.
You: I paid my bill last week!
Caller: Our records show no payment. To stop the shutoff you must pay four hundred dollars immediately using Zelle or a prepaid card.
You: Can I call the number on my bill?
Caller: There's no time for that ma'am. If you hang up, the technician will disconnect you.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Hi, this is Amazon customer service. We owe you a refund of forty nine dollars for a cancelled subscription.
You: Oh, that's nice.
Caller: I'll need remote access to your computer to process it. Okay, oh no, I accidentally sent you four thousand nine hundred dollars instead. I could lose my job.
You: Oh dear. What should I do?
Caller: Please send back the difference using gift cards so my manager doesn't find out. Keep this between us, okay?

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Mom! Mom, help me, please!
You: Sarah? Sarah, what's wrong?
Caller: Listen to me carefully. We have your daughter. If you want to see her again, you will do exactly what I say.
You: Oh my God. Please don't hurt her.
Caller: Do not call the police. Do not hang up this phone. Go to the bank and wire five thousand dollars to the account I give you. You have one hour.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: This is an urgent message from the Social Security Administration. Your Social Security number has been suspended because of suspicious activity in Texas.
You: Suspended? What does that mean?
Caller: It means your benefits and bank accounts will be frozen. To protect your money, we need to move it into a secure government account today.
You: How do I do that?
Caller: You'll withdraw your savings and buy Bitcoin at the machine I'll direct you to. Stay on the line with me the whole time.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Good afternoon, my name is Attorney Greg Collins. I'm representing your grandson Michael. He was arrested after a car accident last night.
You: Michael? Is he alright?
Caller: He's fine, but the judge set bail at eight thousand dollars. He asked me to call you because he's too embarrassed to call his parents.
You: I should talk to his father first.
Caller: There's a gag order on the case, so you can't discuss it with anyone. A courier can come pick up the cash from your house this afternoon.

items.label: scam
items.text:
Caller: Hi, it's Kevin from Golden Coin Investments. Last week you showed interest in our retirement growth program.
You: I don't think so.
Caller: Well, it's not too late. Our members are earning thirty percent a month, guaranteed, with zero risk.
You: That sounds too good to be true.
Caller: That's why spots are limited. If you move your savings into our crypto wallet before Friday, I can lock in your rate. I just need your bank login to set it up.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hi, this is Linda from Main Street Pharmacy. I'm calling to let you know your prescription refill is ready for pickup.
You: Oh good, thank you.
Caller: We're open until eight tonight, and the copay is the same as last month. Is there anything else you need?
You: No, I'll stop by this afternoon.
Caller: Sounds good. See you then.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hello, this is the front desk at Doctor Patel's office, calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten thirty.
You: Yes, I'll be there.
Caller: Great. Please bring your insurance card and a list of your current medications.
You: Will do. Do I need to fast?
Caller: No, not for this visit. We'll see you tomorrow.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hi Grandpa, it's Lily!
You: Lily! How's my favorite granddaughter?
Caller: Good! Hey, Mom said it's okay to ask, could you help me buy the field trip ticket? It's twenty dollars, she'll pay you back Sunday.
You: Of course, sweetheart. I'll give it to your mom when you all come over for dinner.
Caller: Thank you! I made you a card in art class too.
You: I can't wait to see it.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hi, I'm calling from the township police department community office. We're hosting our annual safety fair this Saturday at the park.
You: Oh, that sounds nice.
Caller: There will be free blood pressure checks and a talk on how to avoid phone scams. No need to sign up, just come by anytime between ten and two.
You: Maybe I'll bring my neighbor.
Caller: Please do. Have a good evening.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hello, this is James from your bank's downtown branch. You asked us to call about opening a savings account for your grandson.
You: Yes, I did.
Caller: Would you like to come in Tuesday or Wednesday? Just bring your photo ID, and we'll handle everything in person.
You: Tuesday morning works.
Caller: Perfect, I've got you down for Tuesday at nine. You'll get a reminder letter in the mail.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hi Ruth, it's Carol from book club!
You: Carol, hello!
Caller: A few of us are going to lunch after church on Sunday. Want to join? We're trying that new Italian place.
You: I'd love to. Should I drive?
Caller: Bob said he'll pick everyone up at noon. See you then!

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hi, this is the driver with your grocery delivery. I'm about five minutes away.
You: Oh great, thank you.
Caller: Would you like me to leave it on the porch or ring the bell?
You: Please ring the bell, I'm home.
Caller: No problem, see you shortly.

items.label: normal
items.type: real family urgency, no money ask (hard)
items.text:
Caller: Mom, it's Tom. Don't worry, everyone's okay, but my car broke down on the highway.
You: Oh no, are you safe?
Caller: Yeah, the tow truck is here already. I'm going to be late picking you up for your appointment, can you call and move it to the afternoon?
You: Of course. Do you need anything?
Caller: No, I'm fine, I'll call you when I'm back on the road. Love you.

items.label: normal
items.type: real support call where USER initiated (hard)
items.text:
Caller: Thanks for calling the help desk at the library. How can I help?
You: I'm trying to log into the e-book app and it sent me a code.
Caller: Great, just type that code into the app yourself. Don't read it to me, I don't need it.
You: Okay, I typed it in. It worked!
Caller: Wonderful. Enjoy your books, and call us back anytime.

items.label: normal
items.text:
Caller: Hello, I'm a volunteer with the local food bank. We're thanking past donors for their support this year.
You: Oh, you're welcome. I'm happy to help.
Caller: We'll be mailing our holiday newsletter next month. If you'd like to give again, there's an envelope inside, but there's absolutely no pressure.
You: I'll look for it.
Caller: Thank you so much, and have a wonderful holiday.
